verdict.rationale: Asking whether a Git hosting service lets users keep their data out of AI training is a fair privacy question, so the axis applies. The evidence contains no AI-training policy, opt-out control, or no-training commitment, including for the managed hosted offering. Self-hosting under the MIT license gives 'full control', but that is a deployment posture and only adjacent to this story, not a documented training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
